newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - American Standard resumed. [CORRECTED 15:28 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - American Standard resumed. [CORRECTED 15:28 GMT]

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley has resumed coverage of American Standard Cos Inc with a strong buy rating (corrects from outperform), the brokerage firm said on Thursday.
-- No further details were immediately released. Analyst Jennifer Pokrzywinski was unavailable for comment.
-- Shares of the Piscataway, N.J.-based manufacturer of air conditioning systems, household fixtures and automotive braking systems closed at 45 on Wednesday.
